name: io.github.Ensi81/avel
title: AVEL
description: Identity/reputation verification layer for agent-to-agent payments across x402, AP2, MPP, and checkout. Reads the proof an agent already produced for its own rail, returns a verdict plus both parties' reputation — never custodies or moves the payment.

environmentVariables.name: AVEL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the AVEL instance to verify against (default: https://aisrail.fly.dev)

environmentVariables.name: AVEL_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key of the agent identity this MCP server represents — signs every verify()/issue_challenge()/verify_challenge()/get_verdict() call. Never exposed as a tool argument.
